title: Lupeol alleviates autoimmune myocarditis by suppressing macrophage pyroptosis and polarization via PPARalpha/LACC1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Xiong, Yulong; Zhang, Zhenhao; Liu, Shangyu; Shen, Lishui; Zheng, Lihui; Ding, Ligang; Liu, Limin; Wu, Lingmin; Li, Le; Hu, Zhao; Zhang, Zhuxin; Zhou, Likun; Yao, Yan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究羽扇豆醇通过PPARalpha/LACC1/NF-kappaB通路抑制巨噬细胞焦亡和极化缓解自身免疫性心肌炎，属纯疾病机制与药物研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Autoimmune myocarditis, with increasing incidence and limited therapeutic strategies, is in urgent need to explore its underlying mechanisms and effective drugs. Pyroptosis is a programmed cell death that may contribute to the pathogenesis of myocarditis. Nonetheless, no direct evidence validated the role of pyroptosis in autoimmune myocarditis. Lupeol (Lup), a pentacyclic triterpene, possesses various biological activities such as antidiabetic properties. However, the effects of Lup on autoimmune myocarditis and pyroptosis remain unelucidated. PURPOSE: This study aimed to reveal the role of pyroptosis in autoimmune myocarditis and explore the protective effects of Lup, and its engaged mechanisms. METHODS: The experimental autoimmune myocarditis (EAM) mouse model was established by immunization with a fragment of cardiac myosin in Balb/c mice. Lup and MCC950 were administered after EAM induction. The protective effects were assessed by inflammation score, cardiac injury, chronic fibrosis, and cardiac function. Mechanistically, the effects of Lup on the M1 polarization and pyroptosis of macrophages were evaluated. Transcriptome sequencing and molecular docking were subsequently employed, and the underlying mechanisms of Lup were further explored in vitro with small interfering RNA and adenovirus. RESULTS: Administration of Lup and MCC950 alleviated EAM progression. Western blotting and immunofluorescence staining identified macrophages as the primary cells undergoing pyroptosis. Lup inhibited the expression of pyroptosis-associated proteins in macrophages during EAM in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, Lup suppressed pyroptosis in both bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) and THP-1-derived macrophages in vitro. In addition, Lup inhibited the M1 polarization of macrophages both in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, the protective effects of Lup were demonstrated via the suppression of the nuclear factor-kappaBeta (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. Transcriptome sequencing and molecular docking revealed the potential involvement of peroxisome proliferator-associated receptor alpha (PPARalpha). Subsequently, we demonstrated that Lup activated PPARalpha to reduce the expression level of LACC1, thereby inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway and pyroptosis. CONCLUSION: Our findings indicated the crucial role of macrophage pyroptosis in the pathogenesis of EAM. Lup ameliorated EAM by inhibiting the M1 polarization and pyroptosis of macrophages through the PPARalpha/LACC1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Thus, our results provided a novel therapeutic target and agent for myocarditis.
abstract_zh: 背景：自身免疫性心肌炎发病率不断上升，治疗策略有限，亟需探索其潜在机制和有效药物。细胞焦亡（pyroptosis）是一种程序性细胞死亡，可能参与心肌炎的发病机制。然而，尚无直接证据验证细胞焦亡在自身免疫性心肌炎中的作用。羽扇豆醇（Lupeol, Lup）是一种五环三萜类化合物，具有多种生物活性，如抗糖尿病特性。然而，Lup对自身免疫性心肌炎和细胞焦亡的影响尚未阐明。目的：本研究旨在揭示细胞焦亡在自身免疫性心肌炎中的作用，并探讨Lup的保护效应及其涉及的机制。方法：通过使用心脏肌球蛋白片段免疫Balb/c小鼠建立实验性自身免疫性心肌炎（experimental autoimmune myocarditis, EAM）小鼠模型。在EAM诱导后给予Lup和MCC950。通过炎症评分、心脏损伤、慢性纤维化和心脏功能评估保护效应。机制上，评估了Lup对巨噬细胞M1极化和细胞焦亡的影响。随后采用转录组测序和分子对接，并在体外使用小干扰RNA和腺病毒进一步探索Lup的潜在机制。结果：给予Lup和MCC950可缓解EAM进展。Western blotting和免疫荧光染色鉴定巨噬细胞为发生细胞焦亡的主要细胞。Lup以剂量依赖性方式抑制EAM期间巨噬细胞中焦亡相关蛋白的表达。此外，Lup在体外抑制了骨髓来源巨噬细胞（bone marrow-derived macrophages, BMDMs）和THP-1来源巨噬细胞中的细胞焦亡。另外，Lup在体内和体外均抑制了巨噬细胞的M1极化。机制上，Lup的保护效应通过抑制核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappaBeta, NF-κB）信号通路得以证实。转录组测序和分子对接揭示了过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（peroxisome proliferator-associated receptor alpha, PPARα）的潜在参与。随后，我们证明Lup激活PPARα以降低LACC1表达水平，从而抑制NF-κB通路和细胞焦亡。结论：我们的发现表明巨噬细胞焦亡在EAM发病机制中起关键作用。Lup通过PPARα/LACC1/NF-κB信号通路抑制巨噬细胞的M1极化和细胞焦亡，从而改善EAM。因此，我们的结果为心肌炎提供了新的治疗靶点和药物。
